name: Veloren
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The open source multiplayer voxel RPG. Installs the server from Veloren's own download server, on the weekly or nightly channel, for x86-64 and ARM nodes; worlds, settings and the admin list are kept.

config.files: {"userdata/server/server_config/settings.ron": {"parser": "file", "find": {"            address: \"0.0.0.0:": "            address: \"0.0.0.0:{{server.build.default.port}}\",", "    server_name: ": "    server_name: \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_NAME}}\",", "    max_players: ": "    max_players: {{server.build.env.MAX_PLAYERS}},"}}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Veloren: downloads the server from Veloren's download server, for the
# chosen channel and this node's CPU. Worlds, settings, the admin list and
# the database in userdata are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
dl=https://download.veloren.net
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case $(uname -m) in
x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
aarch64) arch=aarch64 ;;
*) fail "Veloren's server isn't built for $(uname -m) CPUs." ;;
esac
channel="${VERSION:-weekly}"
channels=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$dl/channels/linux/$arch") || fail "Veloren's download server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
jq -e --arg c "$channel" 'index($c) != null' <<<"$channels" >/dev/null ||
    fail "Veloren has no $channel channel. Set Version to one of: $(jq -r 'join(", ")' <<<"$channels")."
rev=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$dl/version/linux/$arch/$channel") || fail "Veloren's download server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."

# The settings the server's Startup page owns, for the first start; Veloren
# fills in the rest. Later the egg's config edits keep them in step.
cfg=userdata/server/server_config/settings.ron
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    mkdir -p "${cfg%/*}"
    cat > "$cfg" <<CFG
(
    gameserver_protocols: [
        Tcp(
            address: "0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT:-14004}",
        ),
    ],
    max_players: 100,
    server_name: "Veloren Server",
)
CFG
fi

if [ "$(cat .raptor-veloren 2>/dev/null)" = "$channel $rev" ] && [ -x veloren-server-cli ]; then
    echo "Veloren $channel (${rev:0:10}) is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading Veloren $channel (${rev:0:10}), about 450 MB"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/veloren.zip" "$dl/latest/linux/$arch/$channel"
unzip -tq "$build/veloren.zip" >/dev/null || fail "The download from Veloren is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
# The server and the game's assets; the client in the same download isn't needed.
unzip -q "$build/veloren.zip" veloren-server-cli 'assets/*' -d "$build/x"
chmod +x "$build/x/veloren-server-cli"
rm -rf assets.old
[ ! -d assets ] || mv assets assets.old
mv "$build/x/assets" assets
mv -f "$build/x/veloren-server-cli" veloren-server-cli
rm -rf assets.old
echo "$channel $rev" > .raptor-veloren
echo "Installed Veloren $channel (${rev:0:10})."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The channel to install: weekly, which most players are on, or nightly. Players need the same version as the server.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once.
